register.labelZh: DRESS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: dress down 表示穿得較隨便;dress up 則表示穿得較漂亮或正式。；dress up as 可以用來談論孩子、演員或派對參加者裝扮成另一個人物、角色或事物。；dress somebody down 表示嚴厲訓斥某人,語氣比普通地指出錯誤更強烈。；dress something up as something 可以描述有人嘗試用較正面的說法掩飾不好的事實。
register.summaryEn: Dress down describes wearing casual clothes, while dress up describes wearing smarter or more special clothes. Dress up as helps you talk about children, actors or party guests pretending to be another person, character or thing. Dress somebody down expresses a much stronger reaction than simply correcting someone’s mistake. Dress something up as something can describe an attempt to hide an unpleasant truth behind more positive words.
